info.value: ' upaharaRezu iti vA pAWaH ' iti DAtukAvyam . (3.41) ' avaharaRezu ' iti kAtantraSAkawA SAkawAyanacandrAdayaH . ' avahananezu iti pAWAntaram ' iti kzIrataraNgiRyAm . ' vasyati stamBane vaste CAdane vasayet vaset . nivAse vAsayet, snehe vAsayatyupasevane ' (Slo. 187 - 188) iti devaH .

examples: 'pataNge pravasati' (va॰bf॰saM॰27.2). sUrye gaganAdapakAmati, astaM gacCati sati.
'varzagaRaM provAsa' (CAM॰u॰4.4.5). varzapUgaM deSAntare vasatiM cakAretyarTaH.
'amA vE no'dya vasurvasati yo naH prAvAtsIt' (Sa॰brA॰1.6.4.3). apAkramIt, apAgAdityAha.
parimalaH pavanAnusArI diSi digi prAvAtsIt. vistftimagamadityarTaH.
'viDAya vfttiM BAryAyAH pravaset kAryavAnnaraH' (manu॰9.74). videSaM viprakfzwaM deSaM gacCedityAha.
'na me vEraM pravasatyekAhamapi' (hari॰2.50.84). pravasati viSrAmyati viramatItyAhopacAreRa.
'nirvAsayelliNgaM vA savfzaRaM parivAsya' (bO॰Da॰2.1.14). parivAsya=CittvA.
pravAsanaM parAsanaM nizUdanaM nihiMsanam ityamaraH.
'pravAsayed daRqayitvA brAhmaRaM tu vivAsayet' (manu॰8.123). pravAsayenmArayet. arTaSAstre pravAsaSabdasya mAraRe prayogAd iti yAjYa॰2.81 ityatra mitAkzarAyAm.
'tataH pravAsito vidvAn vidureRa narastadA (BA॰Adi॰141.5) pravAsitaH prezitaH.
'muzitaM pravAsitaM cEzAmanirgataM rAtrO grAmasvAmI dadyAt' (kO॰a॰4.90). pravAsitam=anyatra nItaM (Danam).
'yo vE gfheByaH pravasan priyARAM nAnusaMsmaret' (BA॰vi॰4.47). pravasan-prayAn.
'asmin (narake) nivAso'sulaBapravAsaH' (avadA॰SrezWi॰5). pravAso deSAntaragamanam..
'atyantanidropagamAya muktA (SilA) nidrApravAsAya kaperbaBUva (avada॰jA॰24.21). nidrApravAsAyeti nidrApagamAyetyAha.
'pravAsAdupAvfttena kASyapena' (SA॰). pravasatyasminniti pravAso deSAntaram. praSabdo viprarze.
'pUrvavad virAwakramErupasTAyASitvA pravasaTamezyan' (Apa॰SrO॰6.7.24.5). pravasaTaH pravAsaH. sA ha vAguccakrAma.
'saMvatsaraM prozya' (CAM॰u॰5.1.8). prozya=dUra uzitvA.
'nAcAryasyAnapAkftya pravAsaM prAjYaH kurvIta' (BA0 u0 44.15). pravAsa ASramAntare sTitiH.
'dvAdaSarAtraM parivasatyuKAvadaBriM biBrat' (kA SrO0 22.1.21). parivasati tizWati kAlaM kzapayati.
'jApinAM hominAM cEva DyAyinAM tIrTavAsinAm. na parivasanti pApAni…' (va0 Darma0 26.12).. na parivasanti na ciraM tizWanti.
'pUrvedyuragniM praRayedityekaM parokzAntAM parivasedityaparam' (BA0 SrO0 7.4.5). parivaset pari samApayet.
'astamite'pAM pUrRaM (karta) parivAsayet' (ASva0 gf0 2.8.6). parivAsayet odayAttatra vaset tizWet.
'acCinno rAyaH suvIra ityagraM parivAsayati' (Apa0 SrO0 7.1.2.10). parivAsayati Cinatti.
'taM parivAsayati' (Sa0 brA0 3.6.4.17). ukto'rTaH.
'BartA rAjakule kAryavaSAtparyu zitaH' (paYcata0). tatra niSAM sTitaH.
'yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUti paryuzitaM ca yat' ( gItA0 17.10). paryuzitaM rAtryantaritam. kftarAtriparivAsam.
'AryaH paryuzitaM tu nAByavaharatyanDaH kzuDAnDopyasO' (vi0 guRA0 101). ukto'rTaH.
'na ca paryuzitaM vAkyaM svErezvapi kadAcana' (nEzaDo vakti) (BA0 vana0 73.13). paryuzitaM pratijYAtakAlAtilaNGi.
'aparyuzitapratijYeca mArutO pranazwe kOravarAje' (veRI0 6). paryuzitA rAtryantaritA. ahaH-parivAsaviDura-pratiSrave ityarTaH.
'aparyuzitapApAste nadIH sapta pibanti ye' (BA0 Adi0 170.21). aparyuzitapApA niHSezitapApAH.
'tayoranyataraH parivAsitaH' (satyA0 SrO0 24.2.6). parivAsitaH CinnAgraH.
'SulvAtprAdeSe parivAsya vedaparivAsanAni nidaDAti' (Apa0 SrO0 1.2.6.5). parivAsya CittvA. parivAsanAni vedAgrARi. vedo darBamuzwiH.
'iha tayA saha paryuzitam' (svapna0 1). paryuzitamuzitam. anarTakaH pariH.
'liNgaM vA savfzaRaM parivAsyAYjalAvADAya' (bO0 Da0 2.1.1.14). parivAsya CittvA.
'na nAgaloke na svarge na vimAne trivizwape. parivAsaH suKastAdfka rasAtalatale yaTA' (BA0 u0 102.15). parivAso nivAsaH.
'gavAM ca parivAsena BUmiH SuDyati…' (manu0 5.124). parivAso'horAtranivAsaH. kAlaparivAsaH kAlAtyayaH.
'aTavA tadaNgaparivAsaSItalaM mayi kiYcidarpaya' (mAlatI0 9.42). parivAsaH sOraBam.
